purpose: Determine whether the public Chandra archive contains enough source-traceable RX J2129 events to replace the missing machine-readable gas profile with a separately frozen raw spectral/imaging likelihood.
disclosure: Before this freeze, the official TAP result (ObsIDs 9370 and 552; 39.604 ks total), archive file listings, and successful download of 61 standard products were known. A one-observation engineering read of ObsID 9370 found 87, 194, 375, and 409 events in the 0.7-2.0 keV band at 0-1, 1-2, 2-3.5, and 3.5-5 arcsec, respectively. ObsID 552, combined counts, background-scaled counts, X-ray centroid/peak, and every gas-density or gas-mass result were unknown. No gravity residual or independent lens residual was used to select this audit.

frozen_center.origin: same BCG center used by the lens and dynamics protocols

background_screen.interpretation: Area-scaled outer-annulus counts are a conservative local contamination screen, not the final blank-sky plus soft-Galactic background model. Cluster emission in this annulus biases the estimated background high.

failure_rules.count_or_background_failure: Retain the raw archive but do not invest in a four-bin gas likelihood; continue the 30-host inventory.
failure_rules.centering_failure: Treat the fixed BCG-centered spherical gas model as structurally invalid and require a two-dimensional gas likelihood or a different pilot.
failure_rules.pass: Freeze a separate CIAO/CALDB response, PSF, blank-sky, spectral, and deprojection protocol before fitting electron density or gas mass.
